item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 15/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of Guangdong moderating gradually and the band of clouds thinning out today, daytime temperatures will rise slightly over the region. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Sunday. It will be mainly fine and windy over the region early next week. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong persistently in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will be cool in the morning and at night over the region.
